provisionNotices.repeats_other_provision: Iwu e bipụtara dere otu okwu ahụ ebe a dị ka nkebi {{repeated}}, n’okpuru isiokwu “{{heading}}”. Amaghị ezi okwu nkebi {{section}} kwesịrị inwe site na nnomi ọ bụla dị.
provisionNotices.missing_page_secondary_source: Akụkụ nke fọm a adịghị na nnomi gọọmentị e sere foto ya nke e ji mee ihe ebe a. Okwu ndị na-efu sitere na nnomi abụọ nke Iwu ahụ e degharịrị iche iche, ndị kwekọrọ n’onwe ha na akụkụ fọdụrụ na nnomi ahụ.
provisionNotices.minimum_wage_amended_2024: Iwu National Minimum Wage (Amendment) Act 2024 gbanwere nkebi a. Ụgwọ ọnwa kacha nta na nkebi nta (1) bụ ₦70,000 ugbu a, ọ bụghị ₦30,000, oge nyochagharị na nkebi nta (4) bụkwa afọ atọ ugbu a, ọ bụghị ise. Okwu dị ebe a bụ nke afọ 2019.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s17_amended_2024: Iwu Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 agbanweela ngalaba a. Ngalaba nta (2) na-agụ ugbu a "genuineness". Na ngalaba nta (4), mwepu ahụ na-arụ ọrụ ugbu a "except where they are legally verified in Certified True Copies". Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s21_amended_2024: Iwu Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 agbanweela ngalaba a. A ga-akọrịrị ihe merenụ n'ime awa 72 mgbe a chọpụtara ya, ọ bụghị ụbọchị 7 mgbe ọ mere, site na sectoral CERTs ma ọ bụ sectoral Security Operations Centres. Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s22_amended_2024: Iwu Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 agbanweela ngalaba a. Ngalaba nta (1) metụtakwara ndị ọgbakọ ọha ma ọ bụ nke onwe were n'ọrụ, ọ bụghị naanị Financial Institution. Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s24_amended_2024: Iwu Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 agbanweela ngalaba a. Ngalaba nta (1) metụtara ugbu a ozi gba ọtọ, ma ọ bụ nke onye zipụrụ maara na ọ bụ ụgha, iji kpata mmebi iwu na usoro ma ọ bụ iyi ndụ egwu. Ihe ndị mbụ dịka mkpasu iwe na mkparị apụọla. Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s27_amended_2024: Iwu Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 agbanweela ngalaba a. Ngalaba nta (2) metụtara ugbu a onye ọrụ nke ọgbakọ ọha ma ọ bụ nke onwe ọ bụla, ọ bụghị naanị financial institution. Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s30_amended_2024: Iwu Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 agbanweela ngalaba a. Ọ metụtakwara ụzọ teknụzụ ịkwụ ụgwọ ọ bụla ọzọ ugbu a, ọ bụghị naanị ATM na Point of Sales. Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s37_amended_2024: Iwu Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 agbanweela ngalaba a. N'okpuru ngalaba nta (1)(a), ndị ahịa ga-egosikwa National Identification Number nke National Identity Management Commission nyere. Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s38_amended_2024: Iwu Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 agbanweela ngalaba a. E jiri ihe ọzọ dochie ngalaba nta (1). Ndị service providers ga-edebe ma chekwaa traffic data na ozi ndị debanyere aha dịka Nigeria Data Protection Act si kwuo, ruo afọ abụọ. Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s41_amended_2024: Iwu Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 agbanweela ngalaba a. E jiri paragraf ọhụrụ (d) ruo (j) dochie paragraf (d) ruo (h) nke ngalaba nta (1), ha tinyere sectoral CERTs na Security Operation Centres. Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s44_amended: Iwu Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 agbanweela ngalaba a. O kwughachiri levy ahụ, were ngalaba nta ọhụrụ (6) ruo (8) dochie (6), ma tinye ntaramahụhụ ego maka ịghara ịkwụ ya. Site na 1 January 2026, ngalaba 196(14) nke Nigeria Tax Act 2025 hichapụrụ ngalaba nta (2)(a) na (4) na Second Schedule, ndị bụ iwu levy ahụ. Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_s48_amended_2024: Iwu Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act 2024 agbanweela ngalaba a. O hichapụrụ ngalaba nta (4), ya mere iwu gbasara ịkagbu ma ọ bụ ijide paspọtụ onye a mara ikpe anaghịzi arụ ọrụ. Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.cybercrimes_second_schedule_deleted: Ngalaba 196(14) nke Nigeria Tax Act 2025 hichapụrụ Schedule a site na 1 January 2026. Okwu e gosiri ebe a bụ nke 2015.
provisionNotices.penal_code_gap_197_212: Ngalaba 197 ruo 212 adịghị na naanị otu mbipụta nke Iwu a anyị nwere, ya mere ha apụtaghị ebe a. Ha metụtara ihe fọdụrụ na Public Nuisance, Lotteries and Gaming Houses, Cruelty to Animals na ọtụtụ Offences relating to Religion.
provisionNotices.penal_code_gap_364_365: Ngalaba 364 na 365 adịghị na naanị otu mbipụta nke Iwu a anyị nwere, ya mere ha apụtaghị ebe a. Ha metụtara ntaramahụhụ maka forgery na forgery of public seals.
provisionNotices.penal_code_gap_410_477: Ngalaba 410 ruo 477 adịghị na ederede a. Ọ sịrị na e bipụtara ha na Penal Code (Northern States) Federal Provisions Act, nke anyị na-enweghị.
provisionNotices.penal_code_s384_penalty_lost: Naanị otu mbipụta nke Iwu a anyị nwere efuola njedebe ngalaba nta (1), ya mere ntaramahụhụ maka mpụ a apụtaghị ebe a.
